content: उच्चर् €1 <ab>P.</ab> ²1 To go upwards, to rise; बाष्पमुच्चरति <ls>Mbh.</ls>; <ls>K. 14</ls>. .²2 To ascend (as the sun); issue or go forth, go up; बलैश्चलच्चरणविधूतमुच्चरद्धनावलीः <ls>Śi. 17. 52</ls>; <ls>Māl. 5. 21</ls>. .²3 To arise, appear forth, rise (as a voice), to be heard; उच्चचार निनदोम्भसि तस्याः <ls>R. 9. 73</ls>, <ls n="R.">15. 46</ls>, <ls n="R.">16. 87</ls>; कोलाहलध्वनिरुदचरत् <ls>K. 27</ls>; <ls>U. 2</ls>; <ls>Ratn. 1</ls>. .²4 To empty the body by evacuations, void oneʼs excrement; तिरस्कृत्योच्चरेत्काष्ठलोष्टपत्रतृणादिना <ls>Ms. 4. 49</ls>. .²5 To emit (sounds), utter, pronounce; शब्द उच्चरित एव मामगात् <ls>R. 11. 73</ls>. .²6 (Used in the <ab>Ātm.</ab>) .³({%a%}) To quit, leave. .³({%b%}) To sin against, be unfaithful (to a husband or wife), transgress against; धर्ममुच्चरते <ls>Sk.</ls> .³({%c%}) To violate or transgress in general, stray or deviate from; पानशौण्डाः पथः क्षीबा वृन्दैरुदचरन्त च <ls>Bk. 8. 31</ls>. .³({%d%}) To rise up to, ascend (<ab>trans.</ab>); यो मघोनि दिवमुच्चरमाणे <ls>N. 5. 48</ls>; <ls>Śi. 17. 52</ls>. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} .²1 To cause to issue. .²2 To utter, pronounce, declare. .²3 To void oneʼs excrement. .²4 To emit.
